aiOverview.content: Truth Social is an American alt-tech social media platform launched in February 2022 by the Trump Media & Technology Group (TMTG), majority-owned by President Donald Trump. Marketed as a "Big Tent" alternative to mainstream platforms like X (Twitter) and Facebook, it aims to promote free expression, particularly for conservative viewpoints, often highlighting political content, "truths," and "retruths". Key Aspects of Truth Social: Origin: Created after Donald Trump was banned from major social media platforms following the January 6, 2021, Capitol attack. Functionality: Similar to X, the platform allows users to create profiles, follow others, and post "truths" (posts) and "retruths" (shares). User Base & Content: The platform has a predominantly conservative audience and is a key channel for Donald Trump to communicate directly with supporters, boasting millions of visits. Ownership & Access: Owned by TMTG and accessible via website, iOS, and Android app stores. Key Features and Differences: "Truths" vs. Tweets: Users share updates, images, and videos in a feed. Content Moderation: Marketed as a "free speech" alternative, it has faced scrutiny for having a lax approach to content moderation compared to larger platforms. Monetization: Relies heavily on advertising, referred to as "sponsored truths".
